::: {#exm-teacher-forcing}

#### The loss on one window

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
x = train_ids[0:seq_len].unsqueeze(0)
y = train_ids[1:seq_len + 1].unsqueeze(0)
logits, _ = lm(x)
window_loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits.reshape(-1, n_chars), y.reshape(-1)).item()
print(logits.shape, y.shape, window_loss)
```

`train_lm()` uses [teacher forcing](#def-teacher-forcing).
For one window of `r py$seq_len` characters,
the network returns `r py$seq_len` rows of `r py$n_chars` [logits](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-logits),
one row per position,
and the [cross-entropy loss](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#def-cross-entropy-loss) compares each row with the true next character.
For the first window of the text,
the trained network's average loss is `r sprintf("%.2f", py$window_loss)`.

:::
